name: A Moon-Kissed Blade
summary: Trevan warns you that worgen threaten Silverpine Forest. Old Fire-Eye resists death through unknown magic, and Trevan asks you to learn what a special blade will require.

sections.title: A smith's list
sections.body: Old Fire-Eye is the worgen who attacked Trevan and his companions. Trevan will give you a list of materials for a weapon against him. The materials are gathered, and Trevan believes he knows a smith who can craft the blade.

faq.answer: Old Fire-Eye is the largest and meanest of the worgen. He attacked Trevan and his companions.

faq.q: Why does Old Fire-Eye keep coming back?
faq.answer: Unknown magic keeps Old Fire-Eye from staying dead.

faq.q: What does Trevan need from me?
faq.answer: Trevan will give you a list of materials needed to forge a special weapon.

faq.q: Why is a special blade needed?
faq.answer: Old Fire-Eye resists death through unknown magic. Trevan says a special weapon is needed to put him down.
Trevan thinks he knows a smith able to craft the blade.

attribution: In-game quest text: A Moon-Kissed Blade
